sections.description: Code Studio and CSS Studio now highlight PHP, modern CSS properties, and CSS functions accurately across the rebuilt editor themes.
sections.changelog:
v1.3.597 — Dev

  • Variable suggestions work on sites that do not use MV’s variables. If your design tokens come from Automatic.css, Core Framework or your theme, they are suggested now — MV reads the stylesheets on the page. WordPress’s own admin tokens are still kept out.
  • The launcher stays at the bottom-right in the WordPress editor. It was being pushed to the top of the screen, over the Save button, by the editor’s own full-height layout. It still lifts clear of a real docked editor.
